scope: Measure Render subphases, repair the dominant measured feedback-frame/first-post-Up cost in existing owners; preserve immediate navigation gains. No new public capability.
preserved_rules: Latest accepted erase suffix, body/pose/mask order/value and full document/Scene/surface/metrics/provider/context/resource identity are mandatory for reuse.
Only a complete valid replacing image plus matched CanonicalVisible can retire the corresponding contribution. Up alone cannot retire it.
Immutable snapshots must remain immutable; reusable buffers catch up all accumulated damage before publishing and remain charged until actual GPU last use.
No drop of accepted input, extra wait after Up, semantic simplification, hidden forced frame or old-camera submission counted as a new feedback frame.
Mask applies per object and z-order/opacity/AA/no-op semantics remain unchanged.
budget_policy: A measured repair may retain charged reusable surfaces within the existing desktop profile; user allows reasonable memory. Do not silently increase all budgets or change input/LOD policy. If required capacity exceeds the profile, return measured requirement for a prospective package amendment.
public_API_impact: None. No SDK API/ABI/exports/schema/version/lock changes. Diagnostic seams private, opt-in and compiled out of ordinary builds.
